## Problem or need

Describe the problem, limitation, or workflow you would like Driftpunkt to improve.

What are you trying to achieve?

## Suggested solution

Describe how you think Driftpunkt could solve this problem.

You do not need to provide a technical implementation.

## Area

Select the area that best matches the request:

- [ ] Tickets
- [ ] Customer portal
- [ ] Technician portal
- [ ] Ticket coordinator
- [ ] Administration
- [ ] Companies and customers
- [ ] Email handling
- [ ] Knowledge base
- [ ] Reporting
- [ ] Status page
- [ ] Installation / deployment
- [ ] Updates
- [ ] API
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Other

## Expected benefit

How would this feature or improvement make Driftpunkt better?

For example:

- Reduce manual work
- Improve usability
- Improve technician workflow
- Improve customer experience
- Improve administration
- Improve reliability
- Improve security
- Add missing functionality

## Alternatives considered

Have you found another way to solve the problem?

If so, describe it here.

## Additional information

Add screenshots, examples, mockups, links, or other information that may help explain the request.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues for the same or a similar request.
- [ ] This request does not contain passwords, API keys, customer information, or other sensitive data.
